content.short: Fragment is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless nft marketplaces within the Web3 ecosystem on TON.
content.description: Marketplace for Telegram usernames enabling secure digital ownership. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Fragment provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on nft marketplaces. By operating on TON, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the NFT Dapps sector. Through continuous innovation, Fragment contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
